data.name: FCL3_001
data.value: Nobody really knows where they are,[pause=10] but {0} says they could be in all sorts of places.

data.name: FCL3_002
data.value: They could be in a dangerous volcano...[pause=0] In a ruined,[pause=10] ancient city lost to time...

data.name: FCL3_003
data.value: ...Or they could be in a place as regular as a forest.

data.name: FCL3_004
data.value: Wherever they are in the world,[pause=10] they each serve a very important purpose.

data.name: FCL3_005
data.value: According to {0},[pause=10] Anima Cores are what allow a region of the world to sustain life.

data.name: FCL3_006
data.value: If something was to break a region's Anima Core...

data.name: FCL3_007
data.value: Well,[pause=10] {0} didn't seem too sure what would happen.

data.name: FCL3_008
data.value: But if I had to guess,[pause=10] that region would probably lose its ability to sustain life properly.

data.name: FCL3_009
data.value: It would be an absolute disaster if something ever happened to one of them.

data.name: FCL3_010
data.value: That's the end of the demo! Thank you so much for playing.

data.name: FCL3_011
data.value: I worked so very hard on this project over the last couple of years...

data.name: FCL3_012
data.value: ...So it means a lot that you would play it!

data.name: FCL3_013
data.value: Please let me know what you think! Writing, gameplay wise, anything!

data.name: FCL3_014
data.value: Oh, and if you find any bugs, please let me know too.

data.name: FCL3_015
data.value: Finishing this game is going to take a long time and a lot of work...

data.name: FCL3_016
data.value: ...So any help you can provide, no matter how small, is huge!

data.name: FCL3_017
data.value: Especially any help with sprites! I want to include more custom sprite work in the future!

data.name: FCL3_018
data.value: Big thanks as always to Audino for all the help he provides and for making PMDO.

data.name: FCL3_019
data.value: Be sure to check the readme that came with New Era : Abyss to Ascension to see the rest of the credits!

data.name: FCL3_020
data.value: I'm going to reset the chapter 3 flags now.

data.name: FCL3_021
data.value: This will send you back to the start of chapter 3 plot-wise...

data.name: FCL3_022
data.value: But you'll keep any items, levels, and that sort of thing that you've gained.

data.name: FCL3_023
data.value: This'll let you playthrough again if you so wish.

data.name: FCL3_024
data.value: Alright. Resetting... Now!
